last_digest.summary: Fixed the heading test in `internal/spec`'s row loop so a pipe-separated data row beginning with `#` (e.g. `#63 | Yes | … | user-confirmed`) is parsed as data rather than truncating the table, split the ATX-heading and `## `-section predicates apart, and added two regression tests covering both directions.

clearGate` now takes `choice, reason string`, records `reason` only when non-empty (map-key omitempty), and `cmd_answer.go` passes `*reason`; added `TestGateAnsweredCarriesReasonAndOmitsItWhenEmpty` covering a reasoned answer, a reasonless answer, and a hand-appended legacy event, all asserting via `bundle.ReadEvents`.

Rewrote internal/finish/skeleton.go and its tests, addressing every review finding — timings-aware slice-column detection, line folding for all free text, the literal `disposition: not yet chosen` line in source-order position, always-rendered reasons, a handled JSON marshal error, and coverage for the legacy slice-less commit, nil state, skipped verification, empty wave_timings, wave-only follow-ups and unknown severities.

Rewrote run-retro.md around the skeleton (seven named sections, numbers-only "grounded in the inputs", no-invention rule, no dispatch→commit), added RunData.SkeletonPath, and added the dedicated table-driven test covering headings and all five load-bearing instructions.

Extracted the retro step into internal/cli/retro.go — one helper derives and atomically writes retro-inputs.json plus the new retro-skeleton.md, and one `retroRunOp` fills the op (now carrying `skeleton_path`) for both `next` and, later, `takt retro`.

done --step retro` now runs its phase and prose-slot guards before the replay short-circuit, so it is accepted in `archived`, still refused in `execute` (even for a matching receipt), and refuses an unfilled `<!-- prose:` slot; the reviewer's nits on double conversion, the untested read-error branch and the unterminated-marker branch are also resolved.
last_digest.blockers: none — except the `finish or archived` predicate shared with internal/cli/cmd_status.go:154, which is outside this task's declared files and left for a follow-up.

last_digest.summary: takt retro --rewrite` now shares one lock with an archived `takt next`, which acquires it before recommitting, so a rewrite's two writes can no longer be committed half-done; the usage wording, closure inlining, takeover-event note, and the two untested branches are also addressed.
last_digest.blockers: none (out-of-scope leftover: internal/cli/archive.go:135's doc comment about "takes no lock, so it passes plainOp" is now stale and needs a one-line fix in a task that owns that file)
